chat_messages: I have Illumina paired-end reads from an E. coli isolate and I just want to run quality control on them. Nothing else — just QC.
consultant_reply:
For a standalone quality control check on your Illumina paired-end reads, I recommend using **FastQC** (`step_qc__fastqc`). It produces per-base quality scores, GC content distribution, adapter contamination reports, and sequence duplication levels in HTML and zip format.

Since you only need QC, no trimming or assembly step is required at this stage. Let me know if you approve and I will generate the pipeline code.
diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph entrypoint
        input_data([getSingleInput])
        step_qc__fastqc(FastQC)
        input_data -->|reads| step_qc__fastqc
    end
```

chat_messages: We sequenced a Salmonella Typhimurium isolate on Illumina and want to adapter-trim the raw reads before any downstream analysis. Please only set up the trimming step.
consultant_reply:
For adapter trimming of your Illumina paired-end Salmonella reads, I recommend **Trimmomatic** (`step_trimming__trimmomatic`). It removes Illumina adapters (ILLUMINACLIP), low-quality leading/trailing bases, and short reads below a minimum length threshold.

This will output paired trimmed reads ready for assembly or mapping. Let me know if you approve this plan.
diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph entrypoint
        input_data([getSingleInput])
        step_trimming__trimmomatic(Trimmomatic)
        input_data -->|reads| step_trimming__trimmomatic
    end
```

chat_messages: I need to map Staphylococcus aureus Illumina paired-end reads to a reference genome using BWA-MEM2. I only need the mapping step — no QC, no trimming.
consultant_reply:
For reference-based mapping of your Staphylococcus aureus reads, I recommend **BWA-MEM2** (`step_mapping__bwa_mem2`). It aligns short Illumina reads to a reference genome with very high accuracy and includes a samtools depth coverage calculation as part of the step.

You will need to provide a reference genome via the `getReference()` channel. Let me know if you approve.
diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph entrypoint
        input_data([getSingleInput])
        ref([getReference])
        step_mapping__bwa_mem2(BWA-MEM2 + Coverage)
        input_data -->|reads| step_mapping__bwa_mem2
        ref -->|reference| step_mapping__bwa_mem2
    end
```

chat_messages: I have aligned BAM files from a Streptococcus pneumoniae study and want to call variants against the reference. Please build just the variant calling step using BCFtools.
consultant_reply:
For variant calling from your aligned BAM files, I recommend **BCFtools** (`step_variant__bcftools`). It uses `bcftools mpileup` followed by `bcftools call` to produce compressed VCF output (`.vcf.gz`) with multi-allelic SNP and indel calls.

This step requires the aligned BAM and the same reference genome used for alignment. Ready to generate the code on your approval.
diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph entrypoint
        input_data([getSingleInput])
        ref([getReference])
        step_variant__bcftools(BCFtools Variant Calling)
        input_data -->|aligned_bam| step_variant__bcftools
        ref -->|reference| step_variant__bcftools
    end
```

consultant_reply:

The output will be paired trimmed reads ready for your downstream assembly. Approve to proceed.
